title: Invitation to the handbook and the divisions of prophecy
english: If anyone wants to know the parts of the divine Scriptures that make for broad learning—I mean the parts about measures and weights—he should not hesitate to consult this handbook. The student of letters must first know how many parts there are in the prophecies. The prophecies have been divided into ten kinds of contemplation, and they contain these: teachings, contemplations, exhortations, threats, lamentations, dirges, prayers, histories, and predictions. Alongside these same prophecies lie the following signs: the rejection of the former people, the rejection of the law according to the flesh, the New Covenant, the calling of the Gentiles, and Christ.
